messages:
shera: quick proposal from today's handoff  create a rotating 'remediation champion' role that owns followthrough for 7 days after any Sev2+ incident :busts_in_silhouette:
nate: how is that different from the PM owner we already assign?
shera: PM owner keeps the long view. remediation champion is a short-term role to drive closure velocity and unblock owners. they coordinate, not necessarily do the work
elaine: love the idea. recurring issues often need someone pushing for a week so they actually land
omar: logistics q: who becomes champion, and how do we rotate it without extra overhead?
shera: idea: champion is oncall-aligned. each oncall block has a "champion window" slot. when an incident happens, IC can request a champion for 7d. if no request, default is no champion
kev: what are their responsibilities?
shera: short list:
- surface blockers daily
- own the remediation card in board (update notes)
- escalate to remediation council if stuck >72h
- run a 15-min weekly triage for active champions (only if >3 active)
nate: can we automate some of this? postmortem-bot could create the champion card and set a 7d expiry
postmortem-bot: FYI: I can auto-create a "remediation-champion" card with expiry and assign to @champion if provided. I can also ping @champion daily at 09:00 UTC with a short status template. (requires board integration)
elsa: small nit: make sure champion handoff works with IC rotation. outgoing IC should request champion before leaving shift and write the champion assignment in-channel
shera: agreed. also want a lightweight status template champ posts daily. pasteable block below:
```
CHAMPION DAILY STATUS
- Incident: #<id> (link)
- Owner(s): @owner1 @owner2
- Today: 1-line progress
- Blockers: short list
- ETA: YYYY-MM-DD
- Escalate: yes/no (if yes, reason)
```
omar: nice. this keeps the thread tidy and searchable
kev: another metric suggestion: track "time-to-first-owner-accept" and "time-to-first-champion-assignment" to measure handoff latency
shera: yes, and tie that to the IC checklist: IC must either assign champion or explicitly decline ("no champion needed") before handoff. if they decline, postmortem-bot tags the PM as "no-champion" so we can measure opt-outs
ate postmortem-bot: Action: implement champion card template + daily ping + opt-out tagging. ETA: 4 days. (requires eng-sre approval for board API keys)
postmortem-bot: Reminder: existing 72h postmortem draft policy still applies. champion role is additive and meant to improve short-term followthrough
nate: comms cadence to stakeholders? propose: champion posts a single-line daily note in incident channel for external stakeholders if there is material change. otherwise weekly summary
elaine: can we add a "recurrence watch" flag on champion cards so champions explicitly say if this looks like a recurring signal? if flagged, postmortem-bot can open a recurrence ticket after 3 flags in 60d
shera: yes, recurrence watch is crucial. champions should have an explicit checkbox: recurrence-watch: yes/no
omar: pilot plan? try champion role for two weeks on all Sev2s in staging region and measure closure rate and ownership lag
kev: I'll add a short checklist update for ICs and champions and put examples in the KB
shera: next steps: 1) add champion role to incident KB (kev) 2) postmortem-bot prototype for card + daily ping + recurrence tagging (nate) 3) update IC checklist and train this week's oncall (elaine) 4) two-week pilot starting Monday (omar)
nate: taking postmortem-bot tasks, will open PR and a board integration request
elaine: will run training during handoff tomorrow and collect feedback
omar: scheduling pilot and will share metrics dashboard links in this thread
shera: thanks everyone. small process role, but should dramatically reduce drifting remediations and help spot recurring patterns faster :chart_with_upwards_trend:
